name: Dumbbell Skullcrusher
instructions: Lay flat on the floor or a bench with your fists extended to the ceiling and a neutral grip.
Break at the elbows until your fists are by your temples. Then extend your elbows and flex your triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit on the bench and hold a dumbbell with both hands. Raise the dumbbell overhead at arms length, holding the weight up with the palms of your hands.
Keep your elbows in while you lower the weight behind your head, your upper arms stationary.
Raise the weight back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Decline Skullcrusher
instructions: Start by lying on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Hold the dumbbells above your chest with your arms extended and your palms facing each other. This is the starting position.
Slowly lower the dumbbells towards your forehead by bending your elbows. Keep your upper arms stationary and only move your forearms.
Once the dumbbells are close to your forehead, reverse the motion by extending your elbows and returning to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Rolling Tricep Extension
instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold a dumbbell overhead.
Flex at the elbows until the dumbbell is behind your head.
Then extend your elbows until the dumbbell is back in the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend at the waist and place your opposite hand on your knee for support.
From this starting position, extend your arm backwards so that the dumbbell is behind your body.
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand tall with a single dumbbell extended overhead.
Flex at the elbow letting the dumbbell travel behind your body.
Try not to let your elbow flare outward.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
instructions: Lay flat on a bench with two dumbbells extended toward the ceiling.
Maintain an overhand grip. Flex at the elbows.
The dumbbells will land on your upper chest/clavicle.
Extend your elbows bringing the dumbbells back into their starting position.
*Named after Dave Tate*

name: Dumbbell Incline Skullover
instructions: Lay flat on an incline bench with two dumbbells pointed toward the ceiling.
Break at the elbows until your forearms touch your biceps, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arms to the sides of your head.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Bench Braced Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Lay sideways on an incline bench and press the elbow of the working arm into the bench.
Use your free arm to pull your upper body into the bench.
Break at the elbow until your elbow is fully flexed, then extend your elbow until the dumbbell is pointed at the ceiling.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Guillotine Press
instructions: Lay flat on a bench.
Push your elbows forward until your biceps touch your forearms. Then extend your elbows until back at the starting position.

name: Dumbbell High Incline Skullover
instructions: Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells above chest.
Flex elbows first, then flex the shoulders until a stretch is felt in your triceps.
Bring your elbows back up until they are pointed at the ceiling, then extend your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Incline Skullcrusher
instructions: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbells above chest with palms facing in.
Bend elbows to lower dumbbells toward forehead under control.
Extend arms fully, squeezing triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Incline Skullcrusher
instructions: Set bench to incline and hold dumbbell above chest with palmsfacing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell toward forehead under control.
Extend arm fully, squeezing tricep at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Seated Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Sit tall holding dumbbell overhead with one hand, arm fully extended.
Lower dumbbell behind head by bending elbow slowly.
Extend arm back up, squeezing triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Skullcrusher
instructions: Lie on flat bench holding one dumbbell above shoulder, palm facing in.
Bend elbow to lower dumbbell beside head without moving upper arm.
Extend arm fully, contracting triceps at the top.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Tricep Guilotine Press
instructions: Lie on bench holding dumbbell above upper chest with palm facing in.
Lower dumbbell toward neck or upper chest by bending elbow forward.
Extend arm fully, squeezing triceps at the top while keeping shoulder stable.
